Independent English verb keep, productive in keeper and upkeep.
keep + -er, a person or thing that keeps.
keep + -ing, the act of keeping or gerund.
up + keep, maintenance; historical formulation upkeeping recorded before upkeep, avoid insist noun from bare verb alone.
